subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should iOS permanently retire the standalone Talk destination and make Chat the single entry point for text, dictation, voice notes, and realtime voice, with existing `talk` and `voice` aliases redirected there?
rationale: The branch intentionally replaces a shipped user-navigation model rather than repairing an established behavioral contract; implementation evidence cannot determine whether that product tradeoff is desired.

options.title: Adopt unified Chat
options.body: Approve Chat as the single conversational destination and accept the preserved aliases as the upgrade route for existing Talk users.

options.title: Keep a separate Talk destination
options.body: Retain the standalone Talk workflow and narrow this work to shared ownership, safety, and presentation improvements that do not remove it.

recommendation.title: Adopt unified Chat
recommendation.body: Approve Chat as the single conversational destination and accept the preserved aliases as the upgrade route for existing Talk users.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review activity explicitly routed this unresolved product-direction question to this person.
